answer: The glacier counter is kept in delta and nebula makes public each reset. A bond is refunded only after 32 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. Anyone therefore has to keep each extra identity continuously active for 32 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. Each duplicate costs another 25 dollars in locked collateral and another 7 days of waiting. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
